gloss: replacing the lock (of a door); lock replacement

definitions.gloss: replacing the lock (of a door); lock replacement
definitions.explanation: Removing the existing lock — and usually the old key — from a door and installing a new one. Routine when a key is lost, after a break-in, or between residents when a rental property changes hands.

examples.japanese: {鍵|かぎ}{交換|こうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{失|な}くした⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{鍵|かぎ}{交換|こうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: I lost my key, so I need to replace the lock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入居|にゅうきょ}→入居：08630_nyuukyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大家|おおや}さん→大家さん：26895_ooyasan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鍵|かぎ}{交換|こうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: When I moved in, the landlord replaced the lock for me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧シリンダー⟦{錠|じょう}→錠：19340_jou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防犯|ぼうはん}→防犯：08192_bouhan⟧⟦{性能|せいのう}→性能：04340_seinou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧もの⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鍵|かぎ}{交換|こうかん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had the old cylinder lock replaced with one with higher security performance.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧ (key; lock) + ⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧ (exchange, replacement). In Japanese, ⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧ refers both to the key and, loosely, to the lock itself, so {鍵|かぎ}{交換|こうかん} most often means replacing the lock cylinder — not just getting a new key cut.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鍵|かぎ}{交換|こうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧: to ask to have the lock replaced
- {鍵|かぎ}{交換|こうかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧: the cost of a lock replacement
- {鍵|かぎ}{交換|こうかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧: a locksmith / lock replacement contractor
- ⟦{入居|にゅうきょ}→入居：08630_nyuukyo⟧⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鍵|かぎ}{交換|こうかん}: lock replacement at move-in
- ⟦{防犯|ぼうはん}→防犯：08192_bouhan⟧⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鍵|かぎ}{交換|こうかん}: lock replacement for security

VERBAL USE:
With ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ the word acts as a verb: {鍵|かぎ}{交換|こうかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to replace the lock. ⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ (to have it done for you) is very common, since most people hire a locksmith rather than doing the work themselves.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {合鍵|あいかぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make a duplicate key — cutting a copy of an existing key, not replacing the lock itself.
- ⟦{錠|じょう}{前|まえ}→錠前：25324_joumae⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧: lock (cylinder) replacement — a more technical synonym; ⟦{錠前|じょうまえ}→錠前：25324_joumae⟧ refers unambiguously to the lock mechanism.
- ⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧: lock repair — fixing a faulty lock rather than replacing it.

USAGE:
In Japanese rental contracts, {鍵|かぎ}{交換|こうかん} is often charged to the new tenant as part of the move-in fees. News stories about break-ins and landlord-tenant disputes also commonly feature the word. Locksmiths advertise heavily under this keyword.
